title: Orphera hypervisor config
description: The config of a hypervisor (a physical KVM host such as gs1), config/<hostname>.yaml: the same top-level `params:` as a per-VM config, with far fewer keys, and `is_hypervisor: true` to say what it is. gen_set_dns.scala can be pointed at it (--config config/gs1.yaml) and then takes its one node from hostname and its resolvers from dns1, dns2 and domainname. A playbook that provisions a VM refuses it.

is_hypervisor.description: Marks the file as a hypervisor's config; always true. Its presence is how Orphera tells this kind of config from a VM config (which has `hypervisor:`) and a DNS config (which has `dns_servers:`).

hostname.description: The hypervisor's node name in the inventory. By convention also the config file's name (config/<hostname>.yaml).

dns1.description: The first resolver: an IPv4 or IPv6 literal.

dns2.description: The second resolver: an IPv4 or IPv6 literal.
